Fonts used by the pibooth.org website, vendored here so that the documentation
shares the same typography:

  AmaticSC-Bold.woff2   Amatic SC (display)  - SIL Open Font License 1.1
  Baloo2-Variable.woff2 Baloo 2 (body)       - SIL Open Font License 1.1

Both are Google Fonts. Keep them in sync with pibooth_pages/src/assets/fonts.
